 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE KHATIM REZA
ORAL ORDER 4 13-09-2024
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.

2. The petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 293 of 2023 instituted for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 323 and 313 of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
3. The case of prosecution, in short, is that the marriage of the complainant was solemnized with petitioner on 18.02.2022.
At the time of marriage, in-laws family demanded a bullet motorcycle from her father.
After intervention of relatives, the marriage was performed and she went to her in-laws house, but she was not kept well for a single day.
The in-laws family always demanded bullet motorcycle and mentally tortured her.

Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.62599 of 2023(4)
dt.13-09-2024 Petitioner brought her hospital on the pretext of treatment and without her consent took her signature over bond paper and got her aborted.
Thereafter, they snatched all her ornaments amounting to Rs. 2,50,000/- and left her in the area of her village.

sentences.text: 1 4. Earlier, at the request of the learned counsel for the parties, the matter was referred to Patna High Court Mediation and Reconciliation Centre for exploring the possibility of amicable settlement of the disputes between both the parties, but from the Mediator's report dated 15-12-2023 (Flag-A), it appears that the mediation between the parties failed.

entities.text: Patna High Court Mediation and Reconciliation Centre
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that on the last date i.e., on 06-09-2024, nobody appears on behalf of the Opposite Party No.2. and the case was adjourned to be listed on 13-09-2024.
Today, also nobody appears on behalf of the Opposite Party No.2.
6. Learned counsel for the petitioner further submits that petitioner is the husband of O.P. No.2.

It is next submitted that in paragraph No.4 of the Complaint Petition, it is specifically mentioned that complainant was earlier married with Sonu Pandey and she is having four years girl child born from wedlock of Sonu Pandey.
The said marriage was dissolved Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.62599 of 2023(4) dt.13-09-2024 by the Sarpanch of Gram kutchery.

It is submitted that this fact has been suppressed by the complainant as well as her parents and without giving information of first marriage, which is legally subsisting till date, she has performed second marriage.
Also, the earlier marriage of the complainant with Sonu Pandey has not been annulled by any Competent Court.
Lastly, it has been submitted that petitioner has no criminal antecedents.
7. Learned APP has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.

8. Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case and submissions of learned counsel for the parties, in the event of arrest or surrender before the Court below within six weeks from today,
the petitioner be released on bail upon furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned CJM Kaimur at Bhabhua, in Complaint Case No. 293 of 2023, subject to the conditions laid down in Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
9. The application stands allowed.

(Khatim Reza, J) shyambihari/-
